listing.name: Custom Chatter, a community driven combat chatter addon.
listing.displayName: Custom Chatter, a community driven combat chatter addon
listing.summary: This, as of current, is a small combat chatter addon mod which adds chatter profiles for a few characters which I thought would be neat to have them.
listing.aiSummary: Adds community-suggested combat chatter profiles for characters from various media.

description: Provides combat chatter profiles for characters like Yharim, Supreme Calamitas, and Kane. The author accepts suggestions for new characters from games, movies, and other media to add as profiles.
